scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.build:server: esbuild server/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=deploy/server.js --banner:js='import { createRequire } from "node:module"; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);' && rm -rf deploy/public && cp -R client/dist deploy/public
